manual_per_fixture_notes.brick-alley.jpg: Correct brick alley, plants, bins and distant buildings. Added cloudy sky is not established by the mostly overexposed sky opening. Old graffiti detail was visibly supported and useful.
manual_per_fixture_notes.canyon-sunset.jpg: Correct red rock landscape, vegetation and cloudy sky. Removes exact sunset inference but omits distinctive warm light; rock positions are broadly consistent.
manual_per_fixture_notes.city-from-above.jpg: Correct city, park, surrounding buildings and water within park. Does not mention high viewpoint or haze; old output also lacked these details.
manual_per_fixture_notes.fjord-overlook.jpg: Correct rocky mountains, vegetation and water corridor. River-flow classification is unverified from pixels; old lake classification was also unverified. Loses old deep-blue detail and omits foreground visitors.
manual_per_fixture_notes.forest-waterfall.jpg: Correct waterfall, cliff, green forest, pool and visible stream. Stream is the waterfall outflow toward the right; alongside wording is imprecise but broadly useful.
manual_per_fixture_notes.highland-road.jpg: Correct winding road through green rocky slopes under cloud. Sharp curve/rock relationship adds useful specificity. No irrelevant road-length warning.
manual_per_fixture_notes.hilltop-castle.jpg: Correct castle, wooded hill and distant landscape/clouds. No irrelevant elevation repetition field; second sentence still partly repeats forest context. White walls/spires omitted as in baseline.
manual_per_fixture_notes.lakeside-dock.jpg: Correct wooden foreground pier/dock, calm lake, mountains, trees, grooves and adjacent wooden post. Weathered appearance is visibly supported; previous causal exposure-duration inference is removed.
manual_per_fixture_notes.northern-lights.jpg: Correct green aurora-like light, night sky, silhouetted tree/hills and stars. Stars explicitly recognized instead of unnecessary exact-count uncertainty.
manual_per_fixture_notes.raspberries.jpg: Correct red raspberries, white cup/saucer and wood. Overlapping fruit is visible. Previous unverifiable freshness claim and exact-count caveat are removed.
manual_per_fixture_notes.sea-foam.jpg: Correct ocean, waves and white foam. Improvement over old generic light/dark water description; green water and overhead viewpoint still omitted.
manual_per_fixture_notes.storm-coast.jpg: Correct dark coastal water/clouds and visible small waves. Previous claim of cloud motion is removed. Bright cloud opening still omitted.
manual_per_fixture_notes.valley-river.jpg: Correct water/river, trees, rock mountains and reflections. Removes redundant forest-density field; flow remains plausible interpretation rather than directly measured motion.
manual_per_fixture_notes.winter-camp.jpg: Correct yellow tent, snow, stone wall and mountain backdrop. Cold/open setting inference is consistent with snow. Snow on tent itself was a useful old detail now omitted.
